query:
SELECT count(*) AS "count!"
                FROM users u
                JOIN handles h ON h.user_id = u.id AND h.released_at IS NULL
                WHERE (
                    $1 = ''
                    OR u.id::text = $1
                    OR h.handle ILIKE ('%' || $2 || '%')
                    OR u.display_name ILIKE ('%' || $2 || '%')
                    OR EXISTS (
                        SELECT FROM user_emails e
                        WHERE e.user_id = u.id
                        AND e.normalized_email ILIKE ('%' || $2 || '%')
                    )
                )
